cohort: 41 women who had previously had cesarean deliveries and presented with irregular perimenstrual bleeding
finding: Women with a history of cesarean delivery combined with irregular perimenstrual bleeding should undergo combined hysteroscopy and ultrasound examination to detect latent scar defects and, if diagnosed, can be treated with either laparoscopic repair or hysteroscopic excision depending on the characteristics of the defect.
mod_finding: This study examined the treatment of cesarean delivery scar defects, finding that laparoscopic repair was effective for women with thin residual myometrium or large defects who desired future pregnancies.
